morning.caption:
A new Desert Research Institute study finds 39 proposed Nevada data centers could use about 4 billion gallons a year for cooling by 2036, while the power plants serving them would consume nearly twice as much water again.

Full edition: watercapitalwire.com

afternoon.caption:
Diamondback Energy and KKR are buying Five Point Infrastructure's 70% of Deep Blue Midland Basin, taking full ownership of a produced water network of more than 2,000 miles. Bloomberg put the equity value at about $2.1 billion. Closing is expected in the fourth quarter.

More: watercapitalwire.com

#ProducedWater #Permian #PrivateEquity #Water #Infrastructure

evening.caption:
The Saudi Water Authority has cancelled VA Tech Wabag's award for a 300,000 cubic meter a day desalination plant at Yanbu, worth about $272 million, citing internal reasons. It is the second cancellation of the project since 2024.

More: watercapitalwire.com
